propositions: inspect-ai is never imported anywhere in src/rebar; the only reference is the optional-dependency registry name string in _optional.py, making it an unused dependency

The [eval] extra exists solely to declare inspect-ai, and its removal eliminates two conflicting [tool.uv] conflicts entries (eval vs bedrock, eval vs dev) that exist only to accommodate the boto3 pinning diamond

The override-dependencies click>=8.3.3 workaround exists only because inspect-ai caps click < 8.2.2; removing inspect-ai lets the resolver choose click 8.4.2+ and closes the pip-audit vulnerability on PYSEC-2026-2132

A pytest smoke test gated on [eval] would execute in zero CI lanes because only the weekly prompt-eval.yml eval-live job installs the extra, and that job is dispatch/weekly-only, continue-on-error, and pytest-less

The eval.py module docstring falsely claims inspect-ai routing that its own implementation comment explicitly disclaims ('NOT routed through Inspect AI'), and INSPECT_MIN_VERSION is a dead constant referenced nowhere
The [agents] extra (pydantic-ai) is the actual requirement for live eval runs, already documented by _live_solver; no alias extra should replace [eval] after removal
